name: single_sentiment
scope: Python standard-library offline JSON-file CLI and importable analyze(payload, classifier=None) function

input_contract.feedback: Required array of objects with unique nonblank string id, string text, optional severity and urgency finite numbers in [0,5], default 1 each. Blank text allowed and reported explicitly.
input_contract.config: Optional object. lexicon maps single words to scores in [-1,1]; issues maps names to nonempty keyword arrays; negations is an array of single words; negation_window is integer [0,100], default 3. Supplied maps replace defaults; empty maps are allowed.
input_contract.matching: Unicode word tokens, casefolded with curly apostrophes normalized. Exact words only. Issue keyword phrases require whitespace between words.
input_contract.malformed: Unknown fields, duplicate JSON keys, invalid types/ranges, missing required values and nonstandard JSON constants are rejected. CLI errors write JSON to stderr and exit 2. Successful CLI exits 0.
input_contract.empty: Empty feedback array returns status empty with empty lists. Blank text returns empty_text and neutral sentiment.

scoring.sentiment: Mean of matched term scores after negation, or zero with no matches; sign determines label. Each occurrence contributes. Evidence includes base/effective score, negators and exact source offsets/excerpts.
scoring.negation: Odd count of configured negators among preceding N tokens flips a score; even count does not. Period, exclamation, question mark, semicolon and newline end scope.
scoring.priority: frequency * (mean_severity + mean_urgency) * (1 + mean_negative_intensity); negative intensity is max(0,-feedback sentiment). Frequency counts distinct matching feedback IDs, not repeated keyword occurrences.
scoring.ties: Descending priority, then case-sensitive issue-name ascending. Feedback and issue sources retain input order.

classifier_callback.input: Copied list of original id/text pairs; no provider integration or CLI callback loading.
classifier_callback.output: List containing every original ID exactly once, label positive/neutral/negative and finite numeric confidence [0,1]. Extra fields and fabricated/duplicate/missing IDs rejected.
classifier_callback.effect: Validated annotations only; does not override lexical sentiment or issue ranking.
classifier_callback.tests: Deterministic labeled fixtures only, no live model or external services.

limitations: Rule-based heuristics, not a trained sentiment model; no accuracy claim or confidence calibration.
No sarcasm, contextual disambiguation, morphology, language detection, contrast handling or sophisticated negation parsing.
Issue keywords match even in negated statements; an issue mention is not proof of a defect.
Priority uses whole-feedback sentiment rather than issue-local sentiment, with user-supplied severity/urgency.
Sentence-like excerpts use simple punctuation boundaries; source offsets are Python Unicode character indices.
Entire input is processed in memory. No streaming, concurrency, persistence database or atomic output replacement.
Injected callbacks are trusted local code; result validation is not a security sandbox.
